text:
maria_support: Customer BrightLeaf (acct BL-873) opened a ticket — daily SFTP ledger CSV for 2025-11-02 is an empty file in the zip, but the dashboard and invoice show ~1.2M tokens for that day. Can someone confirm if the export job ever emitted rows?

eli_sre: I pulled the S3 manifest for that date. manifest references shards 45-49, but shard-47 object is absent from the bucket. Looks like the export worker didn't upload shard-47.

jon_eng: possible worker OOM or commit skipped during the incremental export. Any worker logs around 2025-11-03T01:10Z?

maria_support: I grabbed logs from customer-facing export pipeline and attached them to the ticket. Snip from export-worker logs: 

```
2025-11-03T01:09:58Z INFO export-worker shard=47 start processing
2025-11-03T01:10:12Z ERROR export-worker shard=47 upload failed: i/o timeout
2025-11-03T01:10:13Z ERROR export-worker shard=47 retry exceeded, marking shard as skipped
2025-11-03T01:10:13Z WARN export-coordinator shard=47 commit skipped for date=2025-11-02
```

eli_sre: That explains the empty file. The coordinator marked it skipped so manifest was still generated without the object ref — resulting zip entry with a 0-byte CSV for that shard.

jon_eng: Quick mitigation: re-run the incremental-export for shard 47 for that date only and force re-upload. Command we use in staging: 

```bash
./run_incremental_export --date 2025-11-02 --shard 47 --force-upload --dest s3://redwood-exports/ledger/2025-11-02/
```

jon_eng: I can kick that off now against a backfill queue. ETA ~25m to finish and then we'll push a corrected zip to the customer's SFTP path.

maria_support: Please confirm when uploaded so I can notify BrightLeaf. They'll want the corrected CSV and a note about what happened.

billing-bot: Note: when a shard is skipped but usage was recorded in analytics, invoice delta remains. Reconciliation required if they ask for a credit.

eli_sre: Repro steps for engineering (to validate locally):
1) Run export job for 2025-11-02 with shards 45-49.
2) Kill worker processing shard 47 after it starts (simulate OOM).
3) Ensure coordinator marks commit skipped and manifest is created.
4) Re-run incremental-export with --force-upload and verify S3 object present and manifest updated.

jon_eng: After re-upload we'll run a parity check: compare token sums from regenerated CSV vs dashboard aggregator for that date. Quick parity command: 

```bash
python tools/check_parity.py --csv s3://redwood-exports/ledger/2025-11-02/all.csv --date 2025-11-02
# expected: tokens == 1,201,842 (matches dashboard)
```

maria_support: Thanks — customer asked for ETA on the fixed file and whether invoice will change. If parity matches, no invoice change needed. If tokens differ, we escalate to billing reconciliation.

jon_eng: Backfill job started at 2062350200, re-upload completed at 2062352200. I updated the S3 path and pushed a new manifest. Uploaded object checksum: sha256: d4f7a8b3e9a2c1f4b2a6d5e8c3f1a9b2c7e0a1d5e9b2c3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0a1b2

export-worker-bot: new export zip for 2025-11-02 available at sftp://exports.redwood.com/brightleaf/2025-11-02/ledgers_20251102_v2.zip

maria_support: I've told BrightLeaf it's available and that parity checks are in progress. They'll wait 24h for us to confirm before asking for billing adjustments.

eli_sre: Root cause: transient network timeout during shard upload + coordinator behavior that still emitted manifest without failing the whole job. Action items: (1) make manifest generation transactional (don't reference skipped shards), (2) add retry/backoff bump for upload failures for 5xx/i/o timeouts, (3) alert on zero-byte CSV objects. Filed ENG ticket: ENG-7543.

maria_support: Added ticket link to the customer case and scheduled follow-up for 24h. Closing thread once billing confirms. :white_check_mark:
